去 Sausalito 的船程，本身就可以算半个景点。离开市区后看天际线慢慢退远: The ferry ride to Sausalito is part of the outing. Watch the city recede, then find a bench ashore and slow down. This plan keeps Tiburon, Angel Island and Muir Woods for another day, focusing on the waterfront near the pier and a leisurely meal of your choice.

建议小镇停留 2–3 小时，往返船程与候船另算。先选回程班次，再倒推午餐与散步时: Allow 2–3 hours in town, plus ferry travel and waiting. Choose a return sailing before planning lunch and walking.
本文搭 Golden Gate Ferry，从 San Francisco Fe: This route uses Golden Gate Ferry from the San Francisco Ferry Building terminal, not another operator’s Pier 41 service. Check the departure gate on the day.
Sausalito 单程成人 Clipper/非接触银行卡 $8.50，19–6: One-way Sausalito adult Clipper/contactless fares are $8.50; paper tickets for ages 19–64 are $14. Ages 5–18 and 65+ pay $7. Up to two children age 4 or under travel free per full-fare adult. Each rider needs their own ticket or payment method.

下船先确认返程排队位置，再到旁边公园坐一会儿。看 Angel Island 与湾: Locate the return boarding area before relaxing in the adjacent park. Look toward Angel Island and the bay while everyone adjusts layers and gets water.
沿开放的人行路线走一段，挑喜欢的海景折返；餐厅与商店各有营业时间，别为攻略里的固: Walk an open waterfront section and turn back at a view you enjoy. Restaurants and shops keep their own hours, so choose freely rather than queue for a fixed checklist. Give way on narrow paths and stay off private docks.
返回 · 码头附近休息: Return: a break near the pier
把最后一段休息留在码头附近，再按预留时间去排队。错过一班可能改变跨湾返程，别等店: Take your final break near the pier, then queue with time to spare. Missing a sailing can affect your return across the bay, so check the schedule before finishing your last stop.
海滨公共散步不收景点门票，但这趟不是“零预算”：船票、到 Ferry Build: Public waterfront walking has no attraction admission fee, but budget for ferry fares, travel to the Ferry Building and food. Weekday and weekend schedules differ; check service alerts even after saving a schedule screenshot. Golden Gate Ferry accommodates wheelchair users; arrive at least 20 minutes early and ask staff if you need preboarding. Choose town paths for slopes, narrow sidewalks and weather, returning to the park when tired.
